selector.rationale: The presence of a large, congenital, hyperpigmented patch with satellite lesions and the histopathology showing a compound nevus with large nested melanocytes and bridging at the dermal-epidermal junction are most consistent with Congenital Melanocytic Nevus.

rejected.label: Nevus of Ota
rejected.why: Nevus of Ota typically presents in the ocular and periocular region, which does not match the ankle location in this case.

rejected.label: Epidermolysis Bullosa Nevus
rejected.why: The clinical and histopathological features do not support Epidermolysis Bullosa Nevus, which is associated with blistering skin conditions.

rejected.label: Atypical Nevus
rejected.why: While atypia is noted, the specific features and location are more consistent with Congenital Melanocytic Nevus.
